protocol: 768x512, 257 frames at 25 FPS, seed 42, FP8 weight storage/BF16 compute, one-stage four-step AR, ForeverCache, one full warmup then three measured requests per mode.
loading: fast_infer=False; prompt modules are released before DiT, and DiT before video decoding. Each request reloads models. Sampling + decoding FPS excludes loading, prompt/audio processing and MP4 muxing. This is not streaming playback.
compiled_scope: entire VAE decoder forward per tile
recommendation: Ordinary regional compilation is the simpler default and provides most of the improvement. Autotuning is optional for the additional 2.4% sampling/decoding throughput. Neither reaches 25 FPS; model residency would remove repeated loading, but further transformer optimization is still needed for sustained realtime.
warmup_caveat: Regional first request took 600.52 s with new compiler cache on this machine. Autotune warmup took 655.74 s after reusing kernels from an interrupted tuning attempt; it is not a clean cold-start comparison.

unrestricted_autotune.reason: For a representative 3D convolution, ATen/cuDNN took 13.58 ms while Triton candidates took 55.35-140.12 ms, with tens of seconds of search overhead. Restricted to ATen convs and completed a fresh benchmark; no performance claim is made for the interrupted run.

quality: All measured outputs are finite. Both compiled modes decode all 257 frames with identical source audio. Sampled frames look consistent; outputs are not bit-identical. Eight fixed-input transformer calls and one decoder tile were compared to eager; see quality/*.json. No new 20-minute quality test was run.
inference_source_changes: None required; strict compilation worked without graph-break fixes. Only benchmark launcher and viewer were changed.
